evals.prompt: Write a Markdown document explaining the 3 As of cybersecurity.
evals.expected_output: A tight, bullet-based Markdown document: one statement per bullet, sub-bullets for sub-statements, every line under 120 characters, concise.
expectations: The document covers Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting.
Every non-exempt line is at most 120 characters.
No bullet chains statements with an em-dash or hyphen.
Bullets dominate: at least 80% of content lines are list items.
